subject: general
question:
**Direction: **In this section, item consists of six sentences of a passage. The first and sixth sentences are marked as S1 and S6. The middle four sentences in each have been jumbled up and labelled as P, Q, R and S. This is followed by four options each suggesting a sequence of the sentences. Identify the most appropriate option.

S1 : Vijayanagara or 'city of victory' was the name of both a city and a
solution:
The correct answer is '**QPRS**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence **QPRS **is the most appropriate one based on the context of the passage.
 
• Sentence Q introduces the empire and should be followed by information about the empire. Sentence P provides information about the extent of the empire, which logically follows sentence Q. Sentence R talks about the destruction and desertion of the city, which can be placed after the information about the empire. Finally, sentence S concludes the passage by stating that although the city fell into ruin, it continued to live on in people's memories.
 
• So, the correct sequence is: **QPRS**
